tagline: A desktop-style dashboard for ZimaOS and CasaOS, with IceStore built in
title: IceDash – a desktop for your ZimaOS or CasaOS home server
description: IceDash gives ZimaOS and CasaOS a desktop: apps on a desktop and in a dock, widgets, notifications, Files, a Terminal and IceStore built in. Free and open source.
author: Harman Singh Hira
